name: Greys Court Woodland Play Area
description: Natural play area in the woodland down the driveway, near the tea room and toilets: trees to climb, log piles, a big tree stump, a fallen tree with carved seats and space for den building, with benches for parents.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the National Trust page for prices. National Trust members get in free.
